title: Blood on pillow after 1988 camping trip

tellings.quote: his pillow. You did mention after the camping trip in 1988 you waking up with blood on your pillow,

plain: A former nuclear missile guard named Richard Barth, who says he was abducted by aliens, had said he woke up with blood on his pillow after a camping trip in 1988. Michels brings it up while interviewing Barth, recalling something Barth had told him earlier, as a possible sign that something was done to him during the night.
